critical_code_review_comments: Self-vote detection uses str.endswith on last 10 digits (routes/rewards_campaign.py:685). Works for the current 10-digit numbers but if any participant.phone is stored with country code the endswith comparison is still fine. Consider normalizing p['phone'] the same way (last 12 digits) for symmetry.
public_vote creates the unique index on every insert (line 692). Move create_index into a startup hook so it runs once — insert path is a slow hot loop otherwise.

public_applicants name abbreviation (line 661) uses split(' ')[-1][0] — participants with a single-word name would already be handled but names ending in a title/suffix ('Ananya Rao Jr') will produce 'Ananya J.' which may confuse. Non-blocking.
